ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger Alexa display interests me, but I would keep using my newer Echo Show 5 for now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have the second-generation Show 5 and its stand, so this older version adds little.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a fourth-generation Echo Dot and do not currently need an older one.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Anker Soundcore 2 12W Portable Wireless Bluetooth Speaker: Better Bass, 24-Hour Playtime, 66ft Bluetooth Range, IPX7 Water Resistance & Built-in Mic, Dual-Driver Speaker for Beach, Travel, Party- Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The battery life and water resistance appeal as an upgrade to my older Amazon Tap, but I am not replacing it this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo (4th Gen) | Glacier White with Sengled Bluetooth Color bulb | Alexa smart home starter kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try Alexa-controlled lighting because it adds a useful function to the Echo devices I already use.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It overlaps with my 4K Max, and the themed cover gives me no practical reason to switch.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire 7 tablet, 7" display, 16 GB, (2019 release), Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current tablet need, and another older screen does not solve an obvious problem for me.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Creative Pebble V2 - Minimalistic 2.0 USB-C Powered Desktop Speakers, 3.5 mm AUX-in, Up to 8W RMS Power for Computers and Laptops, Type-A Adapter Included and Extended Cable (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for convenient desk audio alongside my computer peripherals, after checking the connections fit my setup.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Apple AirPods Pro; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Mac accessories do not establish a need for wireless earbuds, and I am not looking for personal listening gear right now.
